name: Garden farming (Nether Wart)
description: Farm crops in the Garden and sell enchanted crops on the Bazaar.
tips: Swap to the crop your best Garden tool is built for, and keep Visitors running for extra copper/coins.

name: Dwarven Mines (Mithril & Titanium)
description: Mine mithril and titanium, sell the enchanted forms on the Bazaar.
tips: Use Mining Speed Boost and Commissions for extra Powder and rewards.

name: Crystal Hollows (Gemstones)
description: Mine gemstone crystals and sell the refined gems.
tips: Gemstone Mining Speed and Mining Fortune matter more than raw damage here.

name: Catacombs Floors 5-6
description: Repeat mid-floor dungeon runs for chest profit.
tips: Buy the chests with the best expected loot and use Dungeon Chest Keys wisely.

name: Catacombs Floor 7
description: Farm Floor 7 for Wither essence and Necron-tier drops.
tips: Skipping to a fast clear time matters more than perfect scores for profit/hour.

name: Master Mode runs (M5-M7)
description: High-end dungeon runs with the best chest loot in the game.
tips: Run with a consistent party; a failed run costs more than a slow one.

name: Kuudra (Infernal)
description: Defeat Kuudra for teeth, essence and Crimson Isle armor drops.
tips: Learn the supply routes; fast, clean runs are what make this profitable.

name: Revenant Horror slayer (T4/T5)
description: Run zombie slayers and sell the drops.
tips: Higher tiers pay far better per hour once you can kill the boss reliably.

name: Voidgloom Seraph slayer (T4)
description: Run enderman slayers in the End and sell the drops.
tips: Bring a Katana-class weapon; the fight is all about burst damage.

name: Crimson Isle / Magma Fields fishing
description: Fish lava creatures and sell their drops.
tips: Sea Creature Chance and Fishing Speed are the stats to stack.

name: Foraging (Galatea / Park)
description: Chop high-tier logs and sell the enchanted forms.
tips: Treecapitator-style axes multiply how many logs you collect per swing.

name: Bazaar & Auction House flipping
description: Buy low, sell high. Not gear-dependent, but needs starting capital.
tips: Spread your coins across several items and never tie up everything in one flip.
